**Measured.** `issue-1631-analytic-swap.test.ts` (28): the holder (student line, muted-row index, the tool's `O`); seven swap spellings and «החלף A ב-G» still a rename; a swap over a shape, a midpoint, three coordinate lines, a named line and an x/y equation line, both directions identical, through the parser, every point where its partner sat, three ask rows answering the same values with no missing object, a parameter `a` and `x`/`y` untouched, AI display sentences; refusals (unknown, same, bad name, through the submit path); the canonical `O` renamed through its sentence (figure identical up to the name), a minted `P₁`, a swap with the tool's `O`, the inline coordinate refused; a free triangle renamed at four seeds identical point by point, a swap exchanging labels in place, the transposition its own inverse, the freed letter never landing on the renamed vertex, the corpus sweep (no map ⇒ no field, and an unrelated map ⇒ identical points); the real store — typed swap → `dispatchSwap` → one commit, seed kept, one undo restores lines/queries/spokenFor/seedNames and redo re-applies; seed names saved and restored; an undone delete realigns display sentences; a refused swap writes nothing. Fails before: 24 of 28 red with the source stashed (`decideSwap is not a function`, holder absent); the 4 green-before are the anti-widening and corpus guards. `issue-1154-rename-point.test.ts`: two cases updated to the new defaults (the tool's `O` is held by its circle line; only a noun-less equation refuses). `npx vitest run src-analytic`: 175 files, 3065 tests green; `npx tsc -b` clean.

**Consequences.** `app/rename.ts` (letter-map core, `decideSwap`, `dispatchSwap`, `letterHolder`, `transposeSeedNames`, `parseSessionEdit`, `decideSessionEdit`), `parser/parseAnalytic.ts` (`parseSwapAnalytic`), `app/submit.ts` (`swap` verdict; trials fold with `current`'s seed names; `decideEdit` takes them), `app/another.ts`, `engine/types.ts` (`Construction.seedNames`), `engine/derive.ts` (third parameter), `engine/evaluate.ts` (seeding reads it), `store/useAnalyticStore.ts` (`applySwap`, `seedNames`, `LetterCommit`, five `swap-*` kinds, undo slice, save field), `app/loadSession.ts`, `app/sessionPersistAn.ts`, `app/errorText.ts` + `i18n/index.ts` (four new texts, `errRenameNotTyped` reworded), `App.tsx` (swap dispatch, seed names threaded — the menu untouched), `app/fallback.ts`, `app/triageReplay.ts`, `parser/catalogAnalytic.ts` (one row). The LLM vocabulary is unchanged in content (the row is `rewrite`), but the proxy bundles the analytic catalogue module: diff the built proxy before deploy. Sibling check (docs/17 §1): 2-D has the swap (ADR-532) and renames auto-letters (ADR-072); 3-D's swap is #1302 (#1631 part 2). Whether 2-D or 3-D seed a free point's default position by its letter (and so move it on a rename) was NOT measured here — a question for the integrator's cross-product lock.

**The surface (#1631, landed with this ADR).** Clicking a POINT opens the shared `LetterPopover` (ADR-W-105) at the click, with the point's measure entries (#1048) inside it, as 2-D's popover carries hide/show. `letterTargetOf` offers it for every point of the figure, including the tool's own letters, and `decideRename` decides. `letterRenameOf` turns a verdict into the popover's answer: a taken letter is answered IN the popover (the holder line and «החליפו בין A ל-B», which reaches `dispatchSwap`); every other refusal keeps this tree's own sentence in the error line. #1154's input pre-fill (`renameDraftOf`, «שנה אות» → «שנה שם A ל-») is retired; the typed «שנה שם A ל-G» and «החלף בין A ל-B» stay. Lock: `letter-swap-1631.test.ts` (the shared §5c rows on a triangle, a derived point and an equation line).

## ADR-AG-193 — The circle's own sentences: a point on it, its named crossings, its centre named and placed, its regions (#1619 B1, #1598)

**Status:** accepted · 2026-10-01 · operator instruction "now we need to work on phase B" (auto-ok on #1619) · stream B1 of #1619 (slice B of #1616)

**Requirements:** [02c](02c-requirements-analytic.md) R130 — new: the 4-point exam's sentences about the circle the figure has are understood; the centre of an unnamed circle can be named by sentence or by click (closes the #1598 gap) · **Design:** [04c](04c-design-analytic.md) — "The circle the figure has" (new section) · **LADDER stage:** parser (frame readings + rules), the M1 apply boundary (four new contextual facts, one name chain), the post-solve selector judge (two `sign` quantities), and the stage-two selector-preference restart (`chordStarts`, before deflation).

**Cites** [ADR-AG-187](#adr-ag-187) (the sentence frame — readings taken only when every clause parses), [ADR-AG-184](#adr-ag-184) (the canonical centre O and its yield rules), [ADR-AG-185](#adr-ag-185) (both crossings in one sentence), [ADR-AG-160](#adr-ag-160) (computed circles), [ADR-AG-005](#adr-ag-005) D7, [ADR-052](06-decisions.md#adr-052), [#1463](https://github.com/dcodish/geo_builder/issues/1463) (deflation).

**Context, re-measured at pickup (`main` @ 596d1b7e).** The 471 corpus stood at **143/263 lines, 5/46 questions**. The foundation the issue's plan proposed to build (`circle-centred`) already existed: «נתון מעגל שמרכזו M» is a centre point plus a free radius symbol, `A על המעגל` resolves the one circle at M1, and «רדיוס המעגל הוא 5» pins the radius. What failed were the exam's sentences ABOUT that circle, each `not-handled` or refused while the relation it states was already representable:
- «O – מרכז המעגל» / «P מרכז המעגל» (#1598: no sentence and no click could name an equation circle's centre);
- «משוואת המעגל הנתון היא …»;
- «A על מעגל M» (a circle named by its centre letter);
- «המעגל עובר דרך A», «… דרך ראשית הצירים O», «מעגל, העובר דרך הנקודות O, C, A»;
- «המעגל חותך את ציר ה-x בנקודות B ו-C» (`bad-operand`), «… בנקודה A», «… את החלק החיובי של ציר ה-x …», «B היא אחת מנקודות החיתוך של המעגל עם ציר ה-y»;
- «מרכז המעגל M נמצא על ציר ה-y / בנקודה (4,8)», «נתון מעגל שמרכזו M נמצא על …»;
- «הנקודה B נמצאת מחוץ למעגל», «E נמצאת על הקשת הקטנה AC»;
- «אורך הקטע AB שווה לרדיוס המעגל», «CD עובר דרך מרכז המעגל»;
- «המעגל משיק לציר ה-x וחותך את ציר ה-y בנקודה C» (two predicates, one subject).

«הישר MB חותך את המעגל בנקודה C» already landed (5/5). «רדיוס המעגל שווה ל-5» (9/5, `ambiguous-shape`) is NOT a phrasing defect: measured, it parses, and 9/5 refuses it because every line that would introduce the circle (an inscribed quadrilateral, a tangent at a point, a diameter) belongs to B2/B3. With no circle in the figure "which circle?" is the honest answer, and it stays.

**The class:** a sentence about **the circle the figure has** — referring to it by «המעגל», by its centre letter, by its equation, or referring to its centre or radius by ROLE — had no reading, even where the relation it states lowers to constraints the engine already solves. The sibling copies of each phrasing were in 2-D (`src/parser`: «מחוץ ל…», «אחת מנקודות החיתוך», «הקשת הקטנה», «מרכז המעגל»), copied by design and missing here; 3-D has no plane-circle topic.

**Decision.**
1. **Spellings of existing sentences lower onto them** (locked by identical facts, the #1618 `same` pattern):
   - the frame drops «הנתון/ה/ים/ות» after a definite noun (an adjective, "the given circle");
   - «X עובר דרך P» with a circle subject is «P על X» (`parseIncidence`'s converse, which declined curve subjects);
   - «אחת מנקודות החיתוך» is the crossing with no ordinal;
   - «M נמצא בנקודה (4,8)» is `M(4,8)` (`pointClauses`);
   - «מעגל, העובר דרך …» — the comma before the relative clause — is the computed circle's own sentence;
   - three new frame readings, each taken only when every clause parses: `centreClauses` («מרכז המעגל M <pred>» → «M מרכז המעגל» + «M <pred>»; «מעגל שמרכזו M <place>» → the circle + «M <place>»), `sharedSubjectClauses` («המעגל <pred> ו<verb> …»), `elidedSubjectClauses` («B נמצאת מחוץ למעגל, על …»).
2. **One name chain for a circle** (`circleByName`). The numeral / `circle-at-<letter>` / student-name lookup was spelled inline four times (`tangent-of`, `radius-of`, `diameter-of`, `tangent-circles`); it is one function now, and it gained the fourth way the exam names a circle — by the letter of a centre named after the circle was stated («נתון מעגל M שמשוואתו …», «M מרכז המעגל»). «מעגל M» as an operand rides the contextual marker with that name (`on-kind.circle`), so «A על מעגל M», «עם המעגל M» and «מחוץ למעגל M» resolve through it.
3. **Naming the centre** (`centre-of`, #1598): which circle is the one with the sentence's equation (the ADR-AG-023/#1342 identity resolver) or the one circle; what the name lowers to follows how that circle was stated — the `circle-centre` derivation for an equation circle (its `already-named` and auto-O yields unchanged), the circumcentre / diameter midpoint for a computed circle (`centreRuleOf`), the centre point itself for a circle on a centre (the same letter is `known`, another is `already-named` naming the holder). An equation no curve has, or no circle at all, states the circle the sentence describes — the creation facts are lowered by the parser from the canonical creation sentence and carried on the fact, so there is no second lowering (the `diameter-of` precedent, #1324). Several circles and no equation: `ambiguous-shape` with the candidates. ADR-AG-184's rule 2 now counts a contextual naming of the one canonical circle, so «P מרכז המעגל» after «x^2+y^2=16» is P with no O beside it. **The canvas ring** (`centresOf`) is offered for an anonymous equation circle with the sentence «P מרכז המעגל ‹equation›», which round-trips; a sole computed circle is offered «P מרכז המעגל».
4. **The centre as a point** (`via-centre`): «CD עובר דרך מרכז המעגל», «מרכז המעגל נמצא על ציר ה-y» are parsed with a sentinel in the centre's place; M1 substitutes the point the centre IS (`centreIdOf`). An unnamed centre is refused `unknown-reference` quoting «מרכז המעגל» — never invented.
5. **The radius as a length** (`radius-length`): «AB שווה לרדיוס המעגל» lowers to `length-eq` with the circle's own radius expression on the right — a free `r_M` is solved, a stated radius is a constant, an equation circle's parameter-free radius is read at the probes; a computed circle's is refused `out-of-scope`, as `radius-of` refuses it.
6. **Regions are selectors** (`circle-region` → the `sign` selector over two new `Quantity` members): «מחוץ למעגל» / «בתוך המעגל» is the sign of the POWER of the point, |PC|² − r²; «על הקשת הקטנה/הגדולה AC» is the sign of the point's side of chord AC times the centre's. D7 kind 2: a region consumes no freedom (`between`'s kind) — a constraint would drop the DOF cue, a sweep bound would never be judged. A value within the solver's resolution of zero is on the boundary and counts as neither side. An arc also states that its point and the chord's ends lie on the circle (absorbed where already given). M1-built selectors are attributed to their line (`FoldResult.selectorFact`, `constraintFact`'s twin), so an unsatisfiable region at 0 DOF is refused on the line that stated it.
7. **Two named crossings of a contextual circle are a configuration.** «המעגל חותך את ציר ה-x בנקודות B ו-C» cannot take ADR-AG-185's ordinals (the pair's canonical order needs the operand resolved), so it lowers to the two crossings with no ordinal: `crossing-distinct` makes them two points (a tangent axis is refused), and which letter takes which root moves with «הציגו תצורה אחרת». A half-axis operand («החלק החיובי של ציר ה-x») adds the `axis-side` selector «B על החלק החיובי …» carries.
8. **The other root of a circle and a straight in closed form** (`chordStarts`). Measured on `main` with the pre-existing canonical sentences («B/C נקודת החיתוך של המעגל עם ציר ה-x» on «נתון מעגל שמרכזו M»): 24/24 seeds "whole", but **9/24 drew a circle of radius 10⁶–5·10⁹** through two crossings a continent apart — the deflated descent (#1463) grows a FREE circle until the collapsed pair separates. A collapsed pair carried by one circle and one straight now first restarts from the partner reflected through the foot of the centre on the straight — the chord's other end, exact, on the circle the solve found — and only then deflates. A pair listed from both crossings' selectors moves once (moving both only swapped the collapse).
9. **English prose is not an equation.** «the circle cuts the x-axis at B» names `x` ("x-axis"), so the circle noun claimed it as an equation (`bad-equation`); the noun gate now asks the bare branch's `HAS_A_WORD` question too — #1068's trap, one rule over.

**Measured.**
- **Corpus:** 143/263 → **162/263** lines; 5 → **6** questions build whole (16/4 joins 8/4, 10/4, 11/4, 12/4, 15/5). Ratchet floor raised to 162 / 6. Newly landing: 6/4 «O – מרכז המעגל»; 11/5 «המעגל הנתון»; 16/4 lines 0, 2–5; 19/5, 22/5, 23/5 «אחת מנקודות החיתוך»; 20/5 lines 2–5; 21/5 lines 0 and 2; 22/5 line 5; 23/5 lines 1–3.
- **Seed sweeps (24 seeds, whole-rate).** Every new sentence was `not-handled` or refused on `main` (0/24). After: 24/24 for the centre placed at (4,8) through O with the y-axis crossing; B outside a stated circle; B outside a free circle; E on the minor arc (stated circle; free circle with A, C on it); the named crossing pair; the half-axis crossing; AB = radius; CD through the centre; «O – מרכז המעגל» with no circle; the centre on the y-axis plus the crossing pair. The crossing pair: B left of C at some seeds and right at others (a configuration, not a default). The chord start: absurd figures (|coord| > 100) 9/24 → 0/24 on the pre-existing canonical form.
- `issue-1619-b1-circle-phrasing.test.ts` (69 tests): identical facts for every spelling (He + En); figures by coordinates (#1598's T51, the centre at (3,4) five ways, the circumcentre of a computed circle, the corpus 23/5 and 16/4 figures, AB = r solving r_M = 5, M on CD); the ring round-trip for four anonymous-circle figures; the 24-seed region and crossing sweeps; refusals (`already-named` holder M, `ambiguous-shape` with two circles / none, `unknown-reference` «מרכז המעגל», `unsatisfiable` on the region's own line, `repeated-vertex`). **On the pre-change source the three touched test files fail 69 of 82** (`git stash` of `engine/` + `parser/`); the 13 that pass are spellings whose canonical form already parsed on both sides.
- `issue-1109-name-centre.test.ts`: «an ANONYMOUS circle is not offered» becomes «… is offered by its equation» — the lock that defended the absent sentence, retired with it.
- `npx vitest run src-analytic shell`: **225 files, 3680 tests, all passing**; `tsc -b` clean. Suite wall time 59.9 s before (with the one retired lock failing) → 67.4 s after (same machine, noisy; `chordStarts` runs only on a collapsed pair).

**Not built — needs a ruling or another stream.**
- **A free radius collapses to its feasibility boundary at every seed** (pre-existing on `main`; a successor issue is to be filed). «נתון מעגל שמרכזו M(6,10)» · «B על המעגל» · «B על ציר ה-y» draws r = 6 (the TANGENT circle) at 24/24 seeds on `main`: the radius is sampled below 6, the solve stops at the first feasible value, so a figure that reports 1 DOF shows one drawing — the #1289 invariant broke when the catalog row for «B היא אחת מנקודות החיתוך…» used that context; the row's context is the free-centre circle instead, and corpus 19/5 line 2 lands into the tangent figure until the sampling is fixed.
- **The definite PREDICATE with three points** («המעגל עובר דרך הנקודות A, B ו-C») still reads as the computed circle (ADR-AG-160) even when the figure already has a circle — a second circle. One or two points now lower to incidences; whether three should too when a circle exists is a ruling (it reaches B2's inscribed forms).
- **Named curves keep ADR-AG-185's deterministic order**, the contextual circle cycles (item 7). A circle named only by its centre letter («המעגל M חותך …») takes the contextual reading. Whether the two should agree is a question for the operator.
- Every corpus line whose circle is introduced by an inscribed polygon, an incircle, a diameter-defined circle or a tangent at a point (9/5, 12/5, 17/5, 18/5, 20/5 line 0, …) waits on B2/B3; their B1 sentences then resolve against that circle through the same facts.

**Consequences.** `engine/types.ts` (facts `centre-of`, `via-centre`, `circle-region`, `radius-length`; `on-kind.circle`; `Quantity` `power` / `arc-side`; `CENTRE_SENTINEL`); `engine/apply.ts` (`circleByName`, `centreRuleOf`, `centreIdOf`, the four cases, `selectorFact`); `engine/evaluate.ts` (`circleQuantity`, `chordStarts`); `engine/derive.ts` (rule 2 for the contextual naming, selector blame by `selectorFact`); `engine/crossings.ts` (the anonymous-circle ring); `parser/frameAnalytic.ts` (three readings, «הנתון», «נמצא בנקודה (x,y)»); `parser/parseAnalytic.ts` (the rules above, `HAS_A_WORD` at the noun gate); `parser/catalogAnalytic.ts` (12 rows, He + En, none featured — #1347's six seats are the operator's). **The proxy bundles the analytic catalogue: the next deploy must push the proxy.** Locks: `issue-1619-b1-circle-phrasing.test.ts`; ratchet floor 162/6. Refs #1619; closes #1598.

## ADR-AG-194 — Inscribed and circumscribed: one rule family over every shape noun, the incircle as a computed circle, side touch points, and «חד זוויות» as a selector (#1619 B2, #1554)

**Status:** accepted · 2026-10-01 · operator: #1619 phase B approved (*"now we need to work on phase B"*, auto-ok the same day); #1554 rulings 2026-09-29 (*"we should support all quads as part of 1554 that can be חסום and חוסם"*; the lock table; ruling 1 on the right trapezoid — see "Needs a ruling") · branch `feat/1619-b2-inscribed` (stream B2 of the #1619 PR)

**Requirements:** [02c](02c-requirements-analytic.md) R131 — new: a polygon of any noun inscribed in a circle (bare, on a centre, by its equation, on a diameter, the circle first, «בר חסימה»), a circle inscribed in a triangle or a quadrilateral, the touch points of the sides, the diameter forms, and «חד זוויות». · **Design:** [04c](04c-design-analytic.md) — new section "Inscribed and circumscribed: the sentence is the sentences it is made of".

**Cites** [ADR-AG-160](#adr-ag-160) (computed circles: no solve, no invented centre letter), [ADR-AG-187](#adr-ag-187) (the sentence frame — a reading is taken only when every clause parses), [ADR-AG-080](#adr-ag-080) (rings), [ADR-AG-189](#adr-ag-189) (the trapezoid's exclusive pair), #1503 (a side's bounded tangency), ADR-AG-005 D7 (the three kinds of inequality), 2-D's #31/#38 (the container marker decides the direction — copied, never imported).

**Context.** Re-measured at pickup (`596d1b7e`): the 471 corpus landed 143/263 lines and 5/46 questions. Every inscribed opener the corpus prints was refused — «מרובע ABCD חסום במעגל» (8/5, 10/5, 15/4), «המרובע ABCD חסום במעגל שמרכזו M» (9/5), «מרובע ABCD חסום במעגל שמשוואתו …» (1/5), «משולש ABC חסום במעגל שקוטרו AC» (4/4), «משולש ABC חסום במעגל שמרכזו O/M» (5/4, 12/5, 18/5), «במעגל (שמרכזו M) חסום משולש חד זוויות ABC» (2/5, 20/5), «הקטע AB הוא קוטר במעגל שמרכזו M» (22/5), «קוטר המעגל AC נמצא על הישר …» (4/4), «במשולש AOB חסום מעגל שמרכזו C» and its touch points (3/5). The one form that existed, `CIRCUM_HE`, read a three-letter run only and required the triangle's vertices to exist already («המשולש ABC חסום במעגל» on an empty canvas was `unknown-reference`, 23/5). No incircle existed at all (#1554's measurement). Most later lines of those questions failed only because the opener did.

**Decision.**
1. **One rule family, the container decides the direction** (`parseInscribed`, `parser/parseAnalytic.ts`). Polygon in circle: «(ה)<noun> RUN (הוא) חסום ב(ה)מעגל <tail>», «… בר חסימה», «(ה)מעגל <tail> (ה)חוסם (את) <noun> RUN», «במעגל <tail> חסום <noun> RUN»; English "… is inscribed in a/the circle (with centre M)", "the circumcircle of …", "circle circumscribing …", "… is cyclic", "cyclic quadrilateral ABCD". Circle in polygon: «מעגל <tail> חסום ב<noun> RUN», «ב<noun> RUN חסום מעגל <tail>», «<noun> RUN חוסם (את ה)מעגל»; "the incircle of …", "a circle inscribed in …", "… circumscribes a circle", "tangential quadrilateral ABCD". RUN is three or four letters; no noun means the generic ring of that arity.
2. **The sentence is lowered as the sentences it is made of.** The polygon is «<noun> RUN» through `parseShape` (every given the noun carries; absorbed by M1 when the ring exists — so the triangle is now drawn when it was not, and bound when it was). The circle is «מעגל <tail>» through the circle rules: «שמרכזו M» is the circle on a centre (`circle-at`), «שמשוואתו …» the equation circle, «שקוטרו AC» the circle on a diameter; it must introduce exactly one circle. No tail (or «חדש») is the circle computed through the first three vertices (`circle-thru`, ADR-AG-160); a numeral tail is that circle's name (the old `CIRCUM_HE` reading, kept). Then each vertex the circle does not already pass through gets an `on-curve` incidence. The triangle is the n = 3 case with zero incidences; `CIRCUM_HE`/`CIRCUM_EN` are deleted. A circle with no stated centre is always created, never bound to a circle already in the figure: creating never imposes a constraint the student did not state (binding to an unrelated circle could), at the cost of a coincident duplicate when the student meant the existing one.
3. **The incircle is a computed circle** — `CircleDef` `{ t: 'incircle'; pts }`, id `circle-in-<ring>`. Centre: `derived.ts` `incircleCentre` — the incentre for a triangle (so it cannot disagree with «מפגש חוצי הזוויות»), the meet of the internal bisectors at the first two vertices for a quadrilateral; radius: the distance to the first side; a degenerate or non-convex ring is a vacancy. A quadrilateral's sentence also states the Pitot condition `AB + CD = BC + DA` as an ordinary `length-eq` (#1554's lowering), so its circle touches the fourth side exactly when the given holds. A named centre on a triangle's incircle is the derived `incentre` point; on a quadrilateral, and any other tail (a radius, an equation), it is refused `out-of-scope` by name.
4. **Touch points** — «הצלעות AO, BO ו-AB משיקות למעגל בנקודות D, E ו-F בהתאמה» (He; English "the sides … touch / are tangent to the circle at … respectively") lowers to one `touch-at` fact per pair, decided at M1 (`apply.ts`): the circle by the `tangent-of` chain; the INCIRCLE of a ring that has the side touches it by construction, so only the point is named; a circle ON A CENTRE gains #1503's bounded `tangent-line` given; any other circle (an equation circle, a circle through points) is refused `out-of-scope`. The point is the new derived rule `side-touch` `{ circle, a, b }` — the foot of the circle's centre on the side (a curve parent, like `touch-point`). «צלעות/קטעים» bound the touch; «ישרים» or no noun do not. A touch AT an end of its own side («AB ו-BC משיקים למעגל בנקודות A ו-C») is NOT claimed: that is the two tangents from a point (#1430, stream B3).
5. **«חד זוויות» is a selector**, `{ kind: 'acute'; ids }` (D7 kind 2): an inequality consumes no freedom, so it is judged inside validity — every angle's cosine above the solver's resolution — `drawableAt` walks to an acute configuration, and a determined triangle that is not acute is refused `unsatisfiable` on the sentence. Peeled off the noun in `parseShape` («משולש חד זוויות ABC», «חד-זווית», "acute(-angled) triangle"), so it works with or without a circle; on any ring other than a triangle the phrase is not read (`not-handled`). Chosen over an `out-of-scope` refusal because the given CAN be honoured; the refusal would have dropped 2/5 and 20/5's opener.
6. **Diameters.** `diameter-of` on a circle through three points now accepts an end that is ON the circle by an incidence, not only by definition (#1554 arm 2): the right angle at a defining point that is neither end. So «BD קוטר במעגל» after «מרובע ABCD חסום במעגל» is judged, not refused, whichever three vertices defined the circle. The frame adds `diameterClauses`: «הקטע AB הוא קוטר במעגל שמרכזו M» → «הקטע AB» · «מעגל שמרכזו M» · «AB קוטר במעגל M»; «הקטע AB הוא קוטר במעגל» states the segment first (it names it, #1074); «קוטר המעגל AC נמצא על …» → «AC נמצא על …» · «AC קוטר במעגל».
7. **A sentence with its givens in parentheses at the end** («… שמרכזו C (הנקודה C נמצאת ברביע השני)») is read as the sentence plus the givens (`parenClauses`) — tried LAST in `readLine`, after the comma split, so it never overrides a rule that owns the whole line, and taken only when every clause parses. The shape frame already did this for a shape declaration; this is the same reading for any sentence.
8. **Catalog:** seven He/En rows in «מעגלים» (unfeatured — the section's six are chosen, #1347).

**Needs a ruling — the right trapezoid.** «טרפז ישר זווית ABCD חסום במעגל» forces a rectangle. #1554's ruling 1 (2026-09-29) says REFUSE; #1627's later ruling (2026-10-01) says givens that force a trapezoid into a rectangle are DRAWN WITH A WARNING (2-D's ADR-165). Not chosen here. Built: the figure is never presented as a valid trapezoid — every seed carries a ring fault (locked), which is what #1627's warning arm will read. With freedom left, `derive` reports nothing today (the ADR-AG-189 gate), so until #1627 arm 2 lands it is drawn without the warning.

**Not built, said out loud.**
- **«מעגל M משיק לצלעות AB, BC, CD, DA»** (#1554 ruling 2b, the spelled-out incircle as a list) and the equivalence lock between it and «מעגל M חסום במרובע ABCD» — the circle-subject tangency list belongs to the tangency reader stream B3 is changing; a named centre on a quadrilateral's incircle is refused `out-of-scope` until then.
- **«מרובע חסום במעגל» with no letters** (log-triage 2026-09-30) — the ring has no names to introduce.
- **«משולש ABC חד זוויות»** (the adjective as a predicate) — not read; the noun-first form is.
- **Binding «חסום במעגל» to a circle already in the figure** (2-D binds when not all vertices pre-exist) — the parser cannot see the figure, and a fact-level binding needs the vertices' pre-existence, which the fold does not carry; deferred.
- **A centre letter on a computed circle** («מרכז המעגל M נמצא על ציר ה-y» after «במעגל חסום משולש ABC», 20/5, 23/5) — stream B1 (#1598): its centre-naming must accept a `circle-thru` host.
- **An equation stated later about a circle on a centre** (12/5 «נתונה משוואת המעגל: …» after «… חסום במעגל שמרכזו M») mints a second circle — stream B1's «משוואת המעגל (הנתון)».
- **A touch on an equation or computed circle** stays `out-of-scope`; stream B3's `tangent-curve` (ADR-AG-195) is the constraint that would lift it — an integration step.

**Measured.** 471 corpus: **175/263 lines, 10/46 questions** (from 143/263, 5/46); newly landing 2/5, 3/5, 4/4, 5/4, 15/4; floor raised to 175/10. Determined figures: 1/5 circle (2,−2) r 10 with A, B, C, D on it; 2/5 M(4,−1), r 5; 3/5 A(−8,0), B(0,6), C(−2,2), D(−2,0), E(0,2), F(−3.2,3.6), r 2; 4/4 C(3.4,3.6); 8/5 B(4,4); 10/5 B(−2,0), D(6,0); 15/4 C(4,10), E(2,6), circle x² + (y−7)² = 25, ∠A = ∠C = 90°, and «BD קוטר במעגל» answers `already-follows`. 24-seed sweeps, whole-rate: «מרובע ABCD» 24/24 before, «מרובע ABCD חסום במעגל» 24/24 after (D on the circle every seed, ring simple, «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves it); the eight non-contradictory nouns inscribed 24/24 each with the forced shape (טרפז isosceles, מקבילית/מעוין rectangle/square, דלתון right-angled at B and D); all nine nouns circumscribing 24/24 each, tangent to all four sides, מקבילית a rhombus and מלבן a square; «… שמרכזו M», «… שמשוואתו …», «… שקוטרו AC» 24/24; «במעגל חסום משולש חד זוויות ABC» 24/24 acute; the triangle incircle 24/24 tangent to three sides with its centre at the incentre; touch points 24/24 on the circle and on their sides, for the incircle and for a circle on a centre. Lock: `issue-1619-b2-inscribed.test.ts` (44). Fails before: 43 of 44 red with the source reverted (the green one is the «מרובע חד זוויות» not-handled guard), and the ratchet red on the new floor. `issue-1464-1324-1462-kite-exercise.test.ts`: the "incircle voices are not claimed" case now asserts they are claimed as the incircle and never as the circumcircle. `npx vitest run src-analytic shell`: 225 files, 3645 tests green; `npx tsc -b` clean.

**Consequences.** `engine/types.ts` (`CircleDef` `incircle`, `incircleId`, `Fact` `touch-at`, `Selector` `acute`), `engine/derived.ts` (`side-touch`, `footOn`, `incircleCentre`), `engine/evaluate.ts` (the incircle curve, the acute judge), `engine/apply.ts` (`touch-at`, the incident-end diameter, the selector and curve-parent checks), `engine/sameDerivation.ts`, `engine/solve.ts` (description), `parser/parseAnalytic.ts` (`parseInscribed`, `parseTouchList`, `acuteAdjective`; `CIRCUM_*` deleted; the paren reading), `parser/frameAnalytic.ts` (`diameterClauses`, `parenClauses`), `parser/catalogAnalytic.ts` (seven rows), `App.tsx` (the incircle's panel text «○ABC»). The proxy bundles the analytic catalogue: diff the built proxy before deploy. Overlaps for the #1619 integrator: B1 (centre naming on `circle-thru`; the equation-of-the-circle sentence), B3 (`touch-at` vs its tangent-at-a-point lowering and `tangent-curve`; the circle-subject side list; both streams may add a trailing-paren reading).

## ADR-AG-195 — A tangent at a named point is "on the circle, on the line, ⊥ the radius"; the tangent is an object; a determined circle can be touched; chords are accepted (#1619 B3, #1430)

**Status:** accepted · 2026-10-01 · operator: "now we need to work on phase B" (#1619, auto-ok 2026-10-01); #1430 approved 2026-09-27 (batch) and widened 2026-09-29 (side-as-subject arm); ruling 4 on #1616 (2026-10-01): *"Chord: yes. Lift the out-of-scope refusal of a side lying on a circle."* · branch `feat/1619-b3-tangents-chords` (stream B3 of the #1619 PR)

**Requirements:** [02c](02c-requirements-analytic.md) R132 — new: a tangency at a named point, the tangent line as an object with its equation, a line tangent to a circle given by its equation, a tangent from a point, and chords. · **Design:** [04c](04c-design-analytic.md) — new section "Tangency at a point, the tangent object, chords".

**Cites** [ADR-AG-045](#adr-ag-045) (axis tangency, "tangency to a stated LINE is the same equation with a different distance"), ADR-AG-165/#1501 (`tangent-line`, the line-first order), ADR-AG-167/#1504 (circle-to-circle; «בנקודה T»), #1503 (bounded side), ADR-AG-144/#1319 (the free-direction line), ADR-AG-187 (the sentence frame), ADR-AG-178/#1556 (equation vs bound rows), [ADR-052](06-decisions.md#adr-052).

**Context.** Re-measured at pickup on `main` @ 596d1b7e: every #1430 sentence with a point was `not-handled` — «המעגל משיק לציר ה-x בנקודה A», «ציר ה-y משיק למעגל בנקודה A», «הישר BC משיק למעגל בנקודה B», «הקטע CD משיק למעגל בנקודה A», «AB ו-BC משיקים למעגל בנקודות A ו-C בהתאמה», «המשיק למעגל בנקודה A», «משוואת המשיק … היא …», «המשיק חותך את …», «דרך A עובר משיק למעגל». A tangency to a circle stated by its EQUATION was `out-of-scope` (the `tangent-line` residual pins a free radius against a centre point, and an equation circle has neither). A side on a circle was refused `out-of-scope` («a different sentence»), and «מיתר» had no rule. The 471 corpus stood at 143/263 lines and 5/46 questions.

**Decision.**
1. **The radius is a DIRECTION.** `Direction` gains `{ k: 'radius', circle, at }`: from the centre of the RESOLVED circle to the point. `dirVector` reads the centre off `curveAt`, so a circle stated by its centre point, by its equation or computed from points is the same operand. A point at the centre has no direction (`null`, "cannot be judged").
2. **A tangency at a named point is three existing statements.** `tangent-of` gains `at` (and `circleId` for a fact M1 builds). With a touch point, M1 (`applyTouchAt`) lowers it to: `on-curve(A, circle)`, A on the target (`on-line` for an axis, `on-curve` for a named or equation line, `on-line-2pt` for a two-point line unless A is one of its ends), and `relation ⊥ (radius(circle, A), target)`. Those three equations say tangency exactly. No tangent-at constraint kind exists; the incidences are «A על המעגל» and «A על הישר BC», and the perpendicularity is the relation the grammar already has. The parser carries the selectors so `derive` can blame them on the line: the two ends of a two-point line are `distinct` («PA משיק … בנקודה A» with P on the circle has only the degenerate A = P), and a bounded noun («הקטע CD») puts the touch `between` the ends.
3. **Every order, one touch reader.** The singular «בנקודה A» (the #1504 `CONTACT` modifier, which now lands on an axis or line target as well as a circle) and the plural «בנקודות A ו-C (בהתאמה)» / "at the points A and C (respectively)" pair touch points with the targets in the student's order (`TangentTargets.ordered`). The circle-first order («(ה)מעגל (שמרכזו M) משיק לציר ה-x בנקודה A», creating the circle when named) and the line-first order («ציר ה-y / הישר BC / הקטע CD / AB ו-BC משיקים למעגל …») go through one builder, `touchFacts`. The sentence introduces what it names: the touch points and a two-point line's ends (ADR-AG-026's ruling for a named line). «המעגל משיק לציר ה-y בנקודה C וחותך את ציר ה-x בנקודה B» is read as two sentences about one subject.
4. **The tangent is an object.** «המשיק (למעגל (M)) בנקודה A» / "the tangent to the circle at A" builds `tangent-line-at`. M1 resolves the circle by the `tangent-of` chain (`circleNamed`), adds A on it, and adds a `line-at` (id `tangent-A`) through A on the radius direction turned a quarter. That line is 0 DOF and closed-form, drawn and crossed like every constructed line, and its printed equation goes through `knownCurve` like every curve's. One reader (`readTangentNoun`) serves the standalone sentence, the crossing operand («המשיק למעגל בנקודה A חותך את הישר BC בנקודה O», which builds the tangent and its crossing in one sentence) and the equation. Bare «המשיק» is CONTEXTUAL: an `on-kind` of kind `tangent`, meaning the one tangent object in the figure. With none or several, it is refused `ambiguous-shape` naming the host.
5. **The tangent's equation.** «משוואת המשיק (למעגל) בנקודה A היא EQ» builds the tangent at A and states EQ as a CARRIER (`stated: false`) that is tangent at A (decision 2 over that line). An agreeing equation lands, a disagreeing one is `unsatisfiable` on its own line, and the canvas draws one line, not two. Without a point («משוואת המשיק היא 4x + 3y = 40»), `tangent-eq` lets M1 choose. With one tangent object, it is the same claim at that object's touch point. With none, the stated line is drawn and is tangent to the circle (the no-point tangency). With several, it is refused.
6. **A circle the figure determines can be touched (#1430 step 1).** `tangent-curve { circle, line }` means the distance from the RESOLVED circle's centre to the line is its radius. It shares its rows with `tangent-line` (`lineTangencyRows`, extracted, with #1503's bounded rows), so the two cannot measure tangency differently. `tangent-of` on a host that is not `circle-at` lowers to it. The freedom consumed is the line's: «הישר y=kx+10 משיק למעגל x²+y²=25» pins k = ±√3, one root per configuration, and «הישר y=kx+1 …» (a point inside) is `unsatisfiable`. An axis touching a determined circle has no freedom to give and stays `out-of-scope` by name.
7. **A tangent from a point (#1430 step 3).** «דרך (הנקודה) P עובר משיק למעגל» / "a tangent to the circle passes through P" is «דרך P עובר ישר» (the free-direction `line-at`, ADR-AG-144) plus its tangency. The two tangents are the two roots across configurations. From inside the circle it is `unsatisfiable`.
8. **Chords (ruling 4).** The `out-of-scope` arm for a side on a curve is removed. «הצלע BC נמצאת על המעגל» lowers to «B על …», «C על …» and the side, so a parabola's chord is the same. New sentences: «AB מיתר (במעגל (M))», «(ה)מיתר AB», «AB הוא מיתר במעגל», "AB is a chord of the circle"; «במעגל (שמרכזו M) המיתרים AC ו-BD נפגשים בנקודה E» (the bounded crossing of the two SEGMENTS); «… המיתרים AB ו-BC שווים» (|AB| = |BC|). A chord introduces its ends, puts them on the circle named (by centre letter, numeral, or contextual `on-kind`) and draws the segment. «במעגל שמרכזו M» states the circle first (idempotent).

**Not built, said out loud.**
- **The construction imperatives** «העבירו משיק למעגל בנקודה C», «דרך הנקודה D שעל המעגל העבירו משיק», «העבירו מיתר AD», «מהנקודה P העבירו משיקים». They wait on the #1620 ruling. The noun forms above are what they will lower onto.
- **«מהנקודה P יוצאים שני משיקים למעגל»** (two tangents at once). It needs a selector saying the two lines differ, and no such selector exists. One tangent («דרך P עובר משיק») is built.
- **«המשיק והאנך נחתכים בנקודה D»** (5/5). «המשיק» reads, «האנך» is slice C's vocabulary.
- **A determined circle touching an AXIS** («x²+y²−6x=0 משיק לציר ה-y») is `out-of-scope`. It is a claim with no freedom to pin.
- **The plural side noun** «הצלעות AO, BO ו-AB משיקות למעגל בנקודות D, E ו-F בהתאמה» (3/5) is stream B2's (the incircle). This reader declines «הצלעות» on purpose and accepts «הישרים» / bare pairs.
- **6/4 as printed** needs «O – מרכז המעגל» (stream B1). With «נתון מעגל שמרכזו O» in its place the question builds A(2,−1), C(−4,5) (or the mirror) at 24/24 seeds.
- **Pre-existing, measured, not this stream:** «נתון מעגל שמרכזו M» followed by «משוואת המעגל היא (x−3)²+(y−1)²=10» builds TWO circles with no fault (identical on `main`). 7/5 therefore "lands" in the ratchet with its chords on a free circle beside the equation circle. Filed for B1 (the centre/equation reconciliation class); the ratchet counts acceptance, not the figure.

**Measured.** 471 corpus 143/263 → **153/263** lines, 5/46 → **7/46** questions (13/5 and 7/5 complete; floor raised to 153/7, but 7/5 has the two-circle caveat above). 13/5 builds A(6,12), C(12,9), O(0,0), tangent y = 2x. 24-seed whole-rates: tangent-at-point on a free circle («הישר BC משיק למעגל בנקודה B»), on an equation circle («הקטע CD …»), the respectively form, and the tangent object, each **0/24 before (`not-handled`) → 24/24**. y = kx+10 reaches both roots, and the tangent from A(10,0) reaches both tangents. `issue-1619-b3-tangents-chords.test.ts` (31 tests). With the source reverse-applied, 30 of the 31 and the ratchet are red; the 1 green-before is the side-as-subject identity (shipped by #1503, kept as a regression lock). Updated locks: #1495's "side cannot lie on a circle" → the chord lowering; #1501's "equation circle out of scope" → judged (`unsatisfiable` off, built on); #1504's «בנקודה T» refusal row removed (now a touch point). `npx vitest run src-analytic shell`: 225 files, 3633 tests green; `npx tsc -b` clean.

**Consequences.** `engine/solve.ts` (`Direction.radius`; `tangent-curve`; `lineTangencyRows`), `engine/types.ts` (`tangent-of.at/circleId`, `tangent-line-at`, `tangent-eq`, `on-kind` kind `tangent`, `tangentLineId`), `engine/apply.ts` (`applyTouchAt`, `circleNamed`, `isTangentObject`, the new cases, `tangent-of` on a determined circle), `parser/parseAnalytic.ts` (`peelTouchList`, `touchFacts`, `TangentTargets.ordered`, the two-verb split, `readTangentNoun`, `parseTangentObject`, `TANGENT_FROM_*`, `parseChord`, the crossing operand and «… ואת … בנקודה …», the lifted chord refusal), `parser/catalogAnalytic.ts` (8 rows, none featured). The LLM vocabulary grows by those rows, and the proxy bundles the catalogue, so diff the built proxy before deploy. **Overlap to resolve at integration:** stream B2 builds the incircle's «הצלעות … משיקות … בנקודות … בהתאמה» with its own `touch-at` fact. It is one sentence family with this ADR's touch reader, and the merge should keep one lowering. Sibling check (docs/17 §1): 2-D has tangent-at-point and chords as constructions; 3-D has no circles of this kind.

## ADR-AG-196 — the contextual circle binds to the one circle in the figure (#1633, #1619 integration)

**Status:** accepted · 2026-10-01 · operator: "now we need to work on phase B" (#1619, auto-ok 2026-10-01); #1633 auto-ok 2026-10-01 ("blocks corpus 7/5 and 12/5 inside phase B's own scope"). The binding principle below is the integrator's decision, recorded here for the operator's review · branch `feat/1619-circles` (the #1619 phase B PR: streams B1 [ADR-AG-193](#adr-ag-193), B2 [ADR-AG-194](#adr-ag-194), B3 [ADR-AG-195](#adr-ag-195) merged, then this)

**Requirements:** [02c](02c-requirements-analytic.md) R133 — new: a sentence about «המעגל» means the circle the figure has; «משוואת המעגל היא …» after a circle exists pins that circle; the touch sentence has one reading. · **Design:** [04c](04c-design-analytic.md) — new section "The contextual circle: one binding for every sentence about «המעגל»".

**Cites** [ADR-AG-193](#adr-ag-193) (`centre-of` and its `create`: a sentence about «המעגל» that finds none states it), [ADR-AG-194](#adr-ag-194), [ADR-AG-195](#adr-ag-195), #1324 (`diameter-of`'s contextual reading), #1046 (a coordinate statement about an existing point), #1432 (`radius-of`, the substitution seam), docs/17 §M1.

**Context.** The three streams were built in parallel off `main` @ 596d1b7e and merged here in order B1, B2, B3. Two things needed a decision rather than a merge:
1. **Two lowerings of one sentence family.** B2 read «הצלעות AO, BO ו-AB משיקות למעגל בנקודות D, E ו-F בהתאמה» into its own `touch-at` fact (the incircle's side: a derived `side-touch` point; a circle on a centre: #1503's bounded `tangent-line` plus that point; any other circle: `out-of-scope`). B3 read every «… משיק … בנקודה A / בנקודות … בהתאמה» into `tangent-of` with `at`: A on the circle, A on the line, the line ⊥ the radius, for every circle kind. Both declared a `TOUCH_LIST_HE` (the merge did not compile).
2. **#1633 (P1, found by B3 on corpus 7/5).** «נתון מעגל שמרכזו M» then «משוואת המעגל היא (x−3)²+(y−1)²=10» built TWO circles with no fault, and M stayed at a sampled point. The same class showed up in each stream: B2's «משולש ABC חסום במעגל» after a circle built a second, computed circle; «המעגל עובר דרך הנקודות A, B ו-C» was always a new circle through the three (B1's open question); «משוואת המעגל היא …» with a different equation after an equation circle drew a second circle beside it.

**Decision.**
1. **Merge resolution, every behaviour kept.** `types.ts`: the `Fact` union carries all three streams' members (`on-kind` gets both B1's `circle?` and B3's `kind: 'tangent'`). `frameAnalytic.ts`: B1's `centreClauses` / `sharedSubjectClauses` / `elidedSubjectClauses` and B2's `diameterClauses` / `parenClauses` are all offered, B2's last. `parseAnalytic.ts`: B1's half-axis operand (`peelPart`) is passed into B3's split-out `parseIntersectionPlain`; `parseInscribed` (B2) runs before `parseTangentObject ?? parseChord` (B3), both before `parseCircleAt`. `apply.ts`: B1's `centreRuleOf` learns B2's incircle (a triangle's centre is the `incentre`, a quadrilateral's bisector meet has no derived rule, so its centre stays unnamed); B3's `circleNamed` and B2's touch lookup now use B1's one name chain `circleByName` (no inline copy is left). The corpus ratchet floor is the integrated measurement, below.
2. **ONE touch lowering: B3's, with B2's closed form as its incircle branch.** B3's tangency at a point is the more general mechanism (it holds for a circle on a centre, a circle by its equation, a computed circle), so `touch-at` and B2's `parseTouchList` are deleted. B3's reader takes the plural sentence: `tangentTargets` reads a plural noun heading the whole list («הצלעות» / «הקטעים» bound every piece, «הישרים» does not; "the sides / segments / lines"), the touch list accepts «בנקודות» with or without the article and English "at D, E and F" without "the points", and English "touch(es)" is "tangent to". In `applyTouchAt`, when the circle is the INCIRCLE of a ring and the line is one of that ring's sides, the touch point is B2's `side-touch` derived point (the foot of the centre on the side): the side is tangent by construction, so restating the tangency would solve for a point the closed form gives. A point the sentence only just introduced (declared, no constraint on it) IS that derived point, exactly; one the figure already constrains gets it as a `derived-at` condition. **Consequence:** B2's lock "a touch on an equation circle is `out-of-scope`" is now a build — the triangle's sides are pulled tangent to the stated circle (24/24 seeds). B2 refused it only because its lowering had no way to do it.
3. **THE BINDING PRINCIPLE.** A sentence whose subject is the contextual «המעגל» — no name, no description of its own — binds to THE circle already in the figure when exactly ONE exists. With none, it creates one (B1's «M מרכז המעגל» precedent, #1324's `diameter-of`). With several, it is refused as ambiguous (`ambiguous-shape`, naming the candidates), never a pick. A sentence that DESCRIBES its own circle («חסום במעגל שמרכזו M», «… שמשוואתו …») keeps creating it, unless a circle with that same centre (by `circleByName`, so a centre named after an equation circle counts) or that same equation (`resolveCurveByEq`) already exists — then it binds. One fact carries this for every such sentence: `the-circle { create, about, match? }`, resolved at M1 by one function (`theCircle`). `about` names the circle by `CIRCLE_SENTINEL`, and M1 writes in the resolved id (B1's `via-centre` device). Applied to:
   - (a) **#1633** — «משוואת המעגל (הנתון) היא …» / «נתונה משוואת המעגל: …» (a copula or a colon after the definite «המעגל»; the naming form «משוואת המעגל x²+y²=25» keeps creating). Bound, it is `circle-eq`: an equation circle must be this equation (`known`, else `conflicting-restatement`); a circle on a centre has its centre pinned through the coordinate statement (a free centre letter TAKES the equation's coordinates, exactly) and its radius through `radius-of`, so a placed centre or a stated radius that disagrees is refused on this line (`conflicting-restatement`). A parameterised equation, and a computed circle (`circle-thru`, whose radius follows from solved points — `radius-of`'s refusal for the same circles), are refused `out-of-scope` by name.
   - (b) **«X חסום במעגל» with no description** — bound, every vertex is on the one circle; with none, the computed circle through the vertices, as B2 built it.
   - (c) **«המעגל עובר דרך הנקודות A, B ו-C»** (the predicate form; «מעגל העובר דרך …» describes a circle and keeps creating) — bound, it is «A על המעגל» three times; with none, #1464's circle through the three.
   - (d) **A circle described by its centre letter and its equation** — «נתון מעגל M שמשוואתו …», «משוואת המעגל M היא …» (#1059's reading: the letter is the centre), and inside «… חסום במעגל M שמשוואתו …». It matches by the centre (so a second circle elsewhere is no ambiguity), and bound it is the same `circle-eq` as (a): #1633 with the letter written in, which built two circles the same way. An equation in a described inscribed circle is a statement about the bound circle too, beside the vertices on it.
   The passes that read the fact list before M1 see the creation inside: `derive`'s line-of-object map (`factsWithin`), and the canonical circle's offered centre O, which rides INSIDE the creation and is offered only when a static reading says the sentence will create (no circle before it), so a binding sentence offers nothing.

**Locks** (`issue-1619-integration.test.ts`). The touch: the B2 plural, the B3 singular, the two-tangent and the segment sentences all lower to `tangent-of` with `at`, and no `touch-at` survives; the incircle's touch points are the foot of the centre exactly (1e-12) at 24/24 seeds; a circle on a centre and an equation circle are touched at 24/24; 6/4 still builds A(2,−1), C(−4,5). The binding: #1633's exact sequence (and «הנתון», «נתונה משוואת המעגל:») → one circle, M = (3,1), r = √10 at four seeds; none → one circle; the same equation → known; a conflicting equation against an equation circle, a placed centre, a stated radius, and a later conflicting radius → `conflicting-restatement` on that line; two circles → `ambiguous-shape` for the equation and for «חסום במעגל»; the line-case parity («משוואת הישר AB היא …» about an AB the figure has); «חסום במעגל» on the one circle at 24/24; a described circle binds by centre letter and by equation, and a different centre creates a second; «המעגל עובר דרך הנקודות A, B ו-C» is the same figure as three «X על המעגל» lines; corpus 7/5 and 12/5 draw on the single circle. The FIGURES block locks the newly landing questions at seed 0. B2's three exact-lowering locks now expect the `the-circle` wrapper (the facts inside are unchanged), and its test helper strips `src` at every depth.

**Measured.** 471 corpus: `main` @ fc0aacde 143/263 lines, 5/46 questions; B1 alone 162/6, B2 alone 175/10, B3 alone 153/7; **integrated 214/263 lines, 19/46 questions** [2/5 3/5 4/4 5/4 6/4 7/5 8/4 9/5 10/4 11/4 12/4 12/5 13/5 15/4 15/5 16/4 18/5 19/5 20/5]. Six land only on the integrated tree: 6/4 (B1's «O – מרכז המעגל» + B3's tangents), 9/5, 12/5, 18/5, 19/5, 20/5. Every newly landing figure was checked by hand: e.g. 6/4 OA = (4,−2) ⊥ AB = (6,12), OC = (−2,4) ⊥ CB = (12,6), K = (−1,2) the midpoint of AC and on BO; 7/5 C(4,−2) on the circle, BC ∥ x-axis gives B(2,−2), |AB| = 2 gives A(0.4,−0.8); 9/5 the y-axis tangent at A(0,−4) with r = 5 gives M(−5,−4), crossings (−2,0), (−8,0), D(−10,−4); 13/5 MA ⊥ y = 2x at A(6,12), OC = 15, BC = 3 gives B(9.6,7.2); 19/5 B(0,18), BC ⊥ MB, ∢BCA = 90° at C(−4.8,14.4); 20/5 |MA| = |MB| with M on the y-axis gives M(0,3), r = 5, E on the minor arc with EC = 7. The streams' 24-seed sweeps all hold on the integrated tree.

**Not built, said out loud.**
- **12/5's C is on the far side.** «CD עובר דרך מרכז המעגל» with no noun reads CD as the LINE (the grammar's standing rule for a bare two-letter incidence), so the first configuration has C(4,−7), M on the line CD but not on the segment; the exam's figure has C(4,3). Whether a bare «CD» that the figure already holds as a segment (the altitude) inherits its extent — #1234's inheritance, extended from equations to incidences — is a ruling, not a merge decision — flagged for the operator.
- **11/5** («במעגל המיתרים AC ו-BD נפגשים …» BEFORE «משוואת המעגל הנתון היא …»): with no circle yet, the chord sentence cannot create one — a circle on an unnamed centre would invent a letter (#1167). Its first line stays refused.
- **«משוואת המעגל היא …» about a computed circle** (`circle-thru`) and a parameterised circle equation are refused `out-of-scope` by name: the first needs the equation to drive the circle's points (a carrier would be a second circle to every later contextual reference), the second needs its centre and radius as expressions (no CAS).
- **English** "the equation of the circle is …" has no reading at all yet (not a regression).
- **Two pre-existing defects the play sheet measured (identical on `main` with the canonical spelling «B נקודת החיתוך … / C נקודת החיתוך האחרת …»), reported, not fixed here:**
  - «הציגו תצורה אחרת» does not swap the two named crossings of a fixed circle with an axis: `figureSignature` prints a solved −1e-10 as «-0.0000» and +1e-10 as «0.0000», so the distinct walk counts one picture as several configurations and stops before the swapped seed. Normalising the zero fixes the walk, and turns two #1473 perf locks red (572 line 11: the distinct walk of a determined figure then walks all 24 seeds at render, so the pool is complete before the render and «בודק…» never shows). The locks were measured with the artifact; the trade is ADR-AG-180's ruling, not a merge decision.
  - Two named crossings of a FREE circle that the givens make tangent to the axis («נתון מעגל שמרכזו M», «המעגל משיק לציר ה-x», «המעגל חותך את ציר ה-x בנקודות B ו-C») are recorded with B and C on one point: `crossing-distinct` fails at every configuration, but a failing selector is reported only when the figure has no freedom left (#1069's predicate), and M is free. With a placed circle it is refused (B1's lock).

**Consequences.** `engine/types.ts` (`the-circle`, `circle-eq`, `CIRCLE_SENTINEL`, `factsWithin`; `touch-at` deleted), `engine/apply.ts` (`theCircle`, the two cases, `applyTouchAt`'s incircle branch, `circleNamed` on `circleByName`, `centreRuleOf` for the incircle), `engine/derive.ts` (`lineOf` and `nameCanonicalCentres` read inside `the-circle`), `app/submit.ts` (`restatedCentres` reads inside), `parser/parseAnalytic.ts` (`CONTEXTUAL_CIRCLE_EQ_HE`, `cyclicFacts` and `parseCircleThru` wrap, the plural target noun, "touch", `parseTouchList` deleted). No catalogue row changes, so the LLM vocabulary is the three streams' rows; the proxy bundles the catalogue, so diff the built proxy before deploy. Sibling check (docs/17 §1): 2-D binds «המעגל» through its own contextual-circle reference; 3-D has no circles of this kind.

## ADR-AG-197 — Only valid configurations are evidence: the pool admits configurations whose givens hold, a seed's dead choice yields to a live one, a selector failing across the whole search is refused, a free parameter is resampled inside its feasible region, and the walk compares pictures with tolerance (#1642, #1638, #1635, #1634, #1539)

**Status:** accepted · 2026-10-01 · operator: *"fix these issues so all issues opened here"* (auto-ok on #1642, #1638, #1635, #1634, #1539, ADR-W-014); #1539 carries the operator's ruling of 2026-10-01: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» *"should always swap if there are more than 1 option"*, for two named crossings of the contextual circle with an axis AND for named curves, superseding [ADR-AG-185](#adr-ag-185)'s fixed order for a pair named in one sentence · branch `fix/1637-g1-knowledge` off `feat/1619-circles` (PR #1637, phase B)

**Requirements:** [02c](02c-requirements-analytic.md) R134 — new: a value prints only when the configurations whose givens hold agree on it; two crossings named in one sentence swap under «הציגו תצורה אחרת»; R85 amended (ADR-AG-185's "never cycled" withdrawn) · **Design:** [04c](04c-design-analytic.md) — new section "Only valid configurations are evidence" · **LADDER stage:** configuration choice (`evaluate` before the solve: the seed's `choice` and the cycled pair; `drawableAt`'s callers: pool admission) and the solve's stage two (the interior resample); `derive`'s selector arm. One parser change: `parseChord` emits `distinct`.

**Amends** [ADR-AG-180](#adr-ag-180) (the pool's members are now the ADMITTED drawable configurations; the deferred floor is seeds 0–2), [ADR-AG-126](#adr-ag-126) (the gate's sample is configurations — now also: enough of them), [ADR-AG-185](#adr-ag-185) (the pair cycles), and the #1069 predicate of [ADR-098](06-decisions.md#adr-098)'s analytic port (a selector failing across the whole search is refused whatever the freedom, unless a given already fails).

**Context — five operator/integration reports, one class: a configuration the student's givens contradict, or one the search merely failed to vary, was read as evidence.** Re-measured on this branch's base (b6c462a4):

1. **#1642 (P1, corpus 3/5).** «משולש AOB ישר זווית» · «O ראשית הצירים» · «הצלע BO נמצאת על ציר ה-y» · «הצלע AO נמצאת על ציר ה-x» · «במשולש AOB חסום מעגל שמרכזו C» · «הנקודה C נמצאת ברביע השני»: 2 DOF, **1 of 24 raw seeds valid** — the `choice` of «ישר זווית» seats the right angle at A or B at two seeds in three, and the axis lines contradict both. `drawableAt` walked forward, the pool held two pictures (5 + 19 seeds), and the panel printed «A = (−4.16, 0) או [(−3.78, 0)]», «B = [(0, 4.83)] או (0, 5.39)», «C = (−1.37, 1.37) או [(−1.24, 1.24)]» for a figure in which none of them is knowledge. (The issue's measurement also showed members breaking a given — B = (5.39, 0); on the base re-measured here the two pool pictures were both valid, but nothing stopped a fallback configuration from entering: `drawableAt` returns one when its window holds nothing valid.)
2. **#1638 (P1, corpus 7/5).** «מעגל שמרכזו M» · «המיתרים AB ו-BC שווים» · «משוואת המעגל היא: (x − 3)² + (y − 1)² = 10» · «נתון: C(4,−2)» · «הישר BC מקביל לציר ה-x»: 0 DOF, 24/24 raw seeds "valid", the pool three configurations — A(4,−2) B(2,−2) (9 seeds, A = C), A(4,−2) B(4,−2) (9 seeds, A = B = C) and A(0.4,−0.8) B(2,−2) (6) — so «B = [(2, −2)] או (4, −2)». Nothing said a chord has two ends, or that the sentence's three letters are three points.
3. **#1635 (P1).** «נתון מעגל שמרכזו M» · «המעגל משיק לציר ה-x» · «המעגל חותך את ציר ה-x בנקודות B ו-C»: B and C on one point at 24/24 seeds, `faults: []`. `crossing-distinct` failed everywhere, but `derive` reported a failing selector only at DOF 0 (#1069), and M is free.
4. **#1634 (P2).** «נתון מעגל שמרכזו M(6,10)» · «B על המעגל» · «B על ציר ה-y»: **r = 6 at 24/24 seeds** (the tangent circle), B = (0, 10) printed as knowledge. r is sampled in [1, 4), no crossing exists below 6, stage two moves r, and a least-squares descent from an infeasible sample stops at the first feasible value: the boundary.
5. **#1539 (P2) + ruling.** `figureSignature` printed −1e-10 as «-0.0000» and +1e-10 as «0.0000»: a determined figure counted as three configurations, the distinct walk stopped on the noise, and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» "found" an identical picture. Normalising the zero alone turned two #1473 perf locks red (the integrator's measurement): the deferred pool's floor was `distinctConfigSeeds`, which on a determined figure then walked all 24 seeds at render. Separately, ADR-AG-185's pair («הישר l1 חותך את המעגל I בנקודות A ו-B») never swapped by design — now ruled against.

**Decision.**

1. **Pool admission (#1642).** `judge` (`isKnowledge`), `knownOptions` and `holdsInEveryConfiguration` read only ADMITTED configurations (`admittedToPool`): no unsatisfied given, every selector holding, no ring fault but the trapezoid warning (ADR-AG-189 Am. 1 keeps that one drawable). A vacancy stays admitted (ADR-AG-008): a value that needs the vacant object already reads `null`. `drawableAt`'s fallback tiers are unchanged — the canvas still draws something and `derive` still reports it — but a value read off such a figure is never printed.
2. **Enough configurations (#1642).** On a figure with freedom left (`carrierDof > 0` in an admitted configuration) a value is knowledge only when at least `MIN_WITNESSES = 2` different pictures (tolerance-aware, below) agree; an option-set member needs as many witnesses of its own. One picture always agrees with itself — #1282's class reached through a starved pool. A determined figure needs no witnesses: its pictures are its roots. A starved verdict on a partial (deferred) pool is PENDING, never final.
3. **A seed's dead choice yields to a live one (#1642).** `evaluate` resolves each `choice` by the seed as before; when that option yields no admitted figure, the next options are tried AT THE SAME SAMPLES (`seed + k`, up to the largest choice's size) before the seed is declared invalid. A figure whose every option is valid draws exactly what it drew; the cycle still reaches every live option. `Figure.choiceSeed` records the option taken, and the locus walk resolves its choices at it (`choiceSeedOf`). Chosen over "collapse by implication" because it needs no reasoning about which givens imply which seat: validity decides, as everywhere else in `drawableAt`.
4. **A chord has two ends; one sentence's chords are different chords (#1638).** `parseChord` emits `distinct` over each chord's two ends, and the pair sentence («המיתרים AB ו-BC …») a `distinct` over every letter it names — the polygon's own mechanism, through the noun, never a global rule (ADR-AG-125's positional coincidences are untouched). A selector, not a ring fault, because the selector-steered solve (#1463's deflation and chord reflection) then finds the separated root: 7/5 goes from 6/24 to 19/24 raw seeds on the right configuration.
5. **A selector failing across the whole search is refused, whatever the freedom (#1635).** `drawableAt` returns a figure whose selectors fail only when no seed of its window (25, each with every live `choice` option) had them hold. That is the bounded search ADR-098 reports on, so `derive` refuses the line that stated the failing selector at any DOF — except when a GIVEN already fails in that figure: then the search ran over contradictory configurations, the unsatisfied given carries the refusal, and a triangle's `distinct` collapsing because its givens collapse it is not a second culprit.
6. **A free parameter is resampled inside its feasible region (#1634).** When stage two converges with a parameter moved from its sample and the figure keeps freedom (`figureDofOf > 0`), the moved parameters are pushed on past where the descent stopped — `at + (at − sample) · (0.25 + 1.5u)`, `u` drawn from the seed — and the vertices re-solved with them held there; if that solves inside the domains with the selectors holding, it is the configuration. The infeasible sample says which side is feasible. A parameter a given pins (`a² = 4`, a radius forced to zero) fails the vertex re-solve and keeps its root.
7. **The walk compares pictures with tolerance; the render floor is fixed (#1539).** `figureSignature` spells zero once (`zeroFree`). `sameConfiguration(a, b)` compares the same labelled numbers within `SAME_VALUE_EPS` (relative) — what `distinctConfigSeeds`, `anotherConfiguration` and the starvation test count with, so two solves straddling a rounding boundary are one picture. The deferred pool's synchronous floor is seeds 0–2 (`PENDING_FLOOR`), not "until three different configurations": the same work while the noise split pictures, and the floor B′ always meant.
8. **Two crossings named in one sentence cycle (#1539 ruling, supersedes ADR-AG-185 decision "never cycled").** The pair's two `crossing-nth { both }` selectors are a discrete choice: `evaluate` swaps their ordinals on bit k of the seed for the k-th pair of a figure (`cycledPairs`), configuration 0 keeping the stated order; failing selectors are reported as the STATED objects, so blame is unchanged. `both`'s promise (the pair meets twice) is judged in every configuration as before. A single ordinal («נקודת החיתוך הראשונה») is the student's word and never swaps. The contextual axis pair («המעגל חותך את ציר ה-x בנקודות B ו-C», `crossing-distinct`) already took either root by seed and swaps once the walk stops reading noise.

**Measured** (this branch, `derive` / `evaluate`, 24 seeds):
- #1642: raw valid seeds **1/24 → 7/24**; the pool holds 8 different pictures; the panel prints A «(x_A, 0)», B «(0, y_B)», C «—», O «(0, 0)» — no «או». (The axis lines pin A.y and B.x, so the half-pinned form is the honest row; no coordinate beyond it is printed.)
- Corpus-wide, the 32 analytic-corpus figures carrying a `choice`: **462/768 → 547/768** raw valid seeds.
- #1638: pool = A(0.4,−0.8), B(2,−2) at 24/24; panel B «(2, -2)», A «(0.4, -0.8)»; slope BC = 0; raw valid on the right configuration 6/24 → 19/24.
- #1635: the third line `unsatisfiable`; a free circle not tangent to the axis still gives two distinct crossings, unrefused.
- #1634: r ∈ [6.6, 13.9] over 24 seeds (was 6 at 24/24); B moves; panel B «(0, y_B)»; the #1289 invariant holds on the original catalog context (M(6,10) + «B היא אחת מנקודות החיתוך של המעגל עם ציר ה-y»).
- #1539: 572 reports one configuration and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» offers none; the axis pair and the named-curve pair swap on a press and back.
- Faults over the 1659-figure analytic corpus: exactly ONE figure changes — #1635's own three lines.
- 471 corpus ratchet: **214/263 lines, 19/46 questions — unchanged** (floor stays).
- #1473 perf locks: green. The deferred render path on every determined 572 prefix spends ≤ 3 uncached evaluations; the whole 572 construction (derive, render, pool) ≤ 48; nothing after it.

**Not built.**
- The 1642 figure's remaining 17 invalid raw seeds fail C's quadrant selector (C is the incircle's centre, a derived point the #1071 region seeding cannot fold); `drawableAt` walks past them. Seeding a derived point's region through its parents is a solver change, not this one.
- #1539's "the 14 affected corpus figures equal a 48-seed tolerance-aware sweep" is answered by construction (the distinct walk now IS tolerance-aware), not by a separate 48-seed lock.
- `reports/test-tiers.json` is rewritten only by `test:full`; the new lock file (~24 s, a corpus sweep) is classified on the next full run.

**⚠ Locks moved, recorded rather than quiet.**
- `issue-1512-two-crossings.test.ts`, three sweep locks asserted ADR-AG-185's "never cycled": now configuration 0 is the stated order, both assignments occur across 12 seeds, a press reaches the swap, and a 0-DOF figure swaps on the press. The renaming, spelling and tangent/miss locks are unchanged.
- `issue-1473-perf-budget.test.ts`, "priorConsumers is the honest baseline": on 572 the old distinct walk stopped at seed 2 only because of the «-0.0000» noise, so the relative baseline is lax there by construction once zero is normalised. Restated as the absolute budget it protected: every determined 572 prefix's deferred render spends ≤ 3 evaluations, and the pool is left to the idle loop.

**Locks.** `src-analytic/__tests__/issue-1637-g1-knowledge.test.ts` (24): #1642's six lines (rows, whole-rate ≥ 6/24, right angle at O in every valid configuration, ≥ 4 pictures, admission = validity, a genuine discrete set beside a free point still a set) and the class sweep — over the analytic corpus every printed coordinate and option member is witnessed by an admitted configuration (> 400 figures, > 1000 values); #1638's pool, rows and slope, 24-seed no-collapse, a two-configuration chord figure still two, one chord never collapsed; #1635's refusal and its free control; #1634's r > 6.1 at ≥ 18/24 seeds, the moving crossing, the #1289 catalog row, a pinned radius unpushed; #1539's zero spelling, a determined figure with no other configuration, 572 = one configuration, the axis pair and the named-curve pair swapping, a single ordinal never swapping, the three-seed floor. **Fails before:** 15 of 24 (the other 9 are controls), plus the 3 amended #1512 locks.

**Consequences.** `engine/evaluate.ts` (`evaluateTryingChoices`, `choiceSeedOf`, `Figure.choiceSeed`, `cycledPairs`, `admittedToPool`, `hardRingFaults`, `MIN_WITNESSES` / `starved`, `judge` / `knownOptions` / `holdsInEveryConfiguration` on admitted figures, `resampledInside`, `figureSignature` / `zeroFree` / `sameConfiguration`, `distinctConfigSeeds` tolerance-aware, `PENDING_FLOOR`), `engine/derive.ts` (the selector arm), `engine/locus.ts` (choices at `choiceSeedOf`), `app/another.ts` (`sameConfiguration`), `parser/parseAnalytic.ts` (`chordFacts` and `chordPairDistinct`). No catalogue row changes. Sibling check (docs/17 §1): 2-D's pool (ADR-558) reads the replay's valid configurations already; its discrete choice cycling and selector search are its own (ADR-098); nothing filed.

## ADR-AG-198 — A sentence draws what it names, the extent belongs to the statement, the frame reads every list and paste, and a tangency states its circle (#1639, #1640, #1636, #1641, #1643, rulings on #1554/#1619)

**Status:** accepted · 2026-10-01 · operator: "fix these issues so all issues opened here" (auto-ok on #1639, #1640, #1636, #1641, #1643, 2026-10-01, ADR-W-014); operator rulings of 2026-10-01 on #1554 (the inscribed right trapezoid is refused) and on #1619 (a tangency with no circle creates it, centre unnamed) · branch `fix/1637-g2-parser` off `feat/1619-circles` (PR #1637, phase B), group G2 of the PR's play-pass fixes

**Requirements:** [02c](02c-requirements-analytic.md) R135 — new: a sentence draws the pair it names; the extent belongs to each statement; point lists and pasted text in every spelling; the inscribed right trapezoid is refused naming both nouns; a tangency sentence with no circle draws its circle. · **Design:** [04c](04c-design-analytic.md) — new section "What a sentence draws, and whose extent it is".

**Cites** [ADR-AG-135](#adr-ag-135) (ruling (a): the figure is the authority on a crossing's extent — kept, made per-statement here), [ADR-AG-187](#adr-ag-187) (the sentence frame), [ADR-AG-194](#adr-ag-194) (the incircle), [ADR-AG-195](#adr-ag-195) (the touch lowering), [ADR-AG-196](#adr-ag-196) (the contextual circle — extended here), #1234 (the noun decides the extent; `inheritExtent`), #1074 (naming a segment introduces its ends), #1080 (a sentence that draws is recorded, not "already follows"), ADR-W-029 (`stripFormatControls`), docs/17 §M1.

**Context — five defects, three classes, measured on `feat/1619-circles` @ b6c462a4 (the operator's PR #1637 play pass, dev log `1ebc4l0w`).**
- **#1639** «BC משיק למעגל בנקודה B», «הישר BC משיק …», «נתון: AC הוא קוטר במעגל»: the relation held and the figure's segments were EMPTY; only the chord rule drew its pair.
- **#1640** the operator's 13/5 lines, then the bare «BC» to see it: `unsatisfiable`. **#1636** 12/5: «CD עובר דרך מרכז המעגל» drew C(4,−7) — the centre on the LINE CD, not between C and D (the exam has C(4,3)).
- **#1641** «A, B, C על המעגל», «נקודות A, B, C על המעגל», «הנקודות A, B, C נמצאות על המעגל», «AO על ציר ה- x» (and two more «ה- x» spellings): `not-handled`. **#1643** a pasted «⁦נמצאת על ציר ה-⁦y⁩», a leading «·», «מרכז המעגל הוא M»: `not-handled`; the touch sentence before any circle: `ambiguous-shape` (its message, `errHost.none.circle`, already read «אין בשרטוט מעגל …» — the CODE is shared by none and many; the text was right).
- **Ruling (a)** «טרפז ישר זווית ABCD חסום במעגל» recorded and drew a ring-faulted rectangle. **Ruling (b)** corpus 6/4 typed line by line refused its first line («AB ו-BC משיקים למעגל בנקודות A ו-C בהתאמה»: no circle) — `derive` only built it by deferring that line past «O – מרכז המעגל».

**The classes (docs/17).**
1. *A relation sentence lowered to constraints on the ENDPOINTS of the pair it names and never declared the pair* — the chord rule declared it, the tangent, diameter, relation, side-on-axis and converse-incidence rules did not.
2. *The extent was decided for the OBJECT, from the whole figure, rather than by the statement.* Two halves: ADR-AG-135's "figure is the authority" promotion ran at evaluation over the COMPLETE construction, so a segment drawn later narrowed an earlier «הישר BC» crossing (#1640); and a bare pair in an incidence was rewritten as «הישר CD» in the parser, blind to the altitude SEGMENT the figure already drew (#1636).
3. *The frame admitted one spelling of a list, and did not normalise what a paste carries.*

**Decision.**
1. **A sentence draws the pair it names, by its noun** (#1639). One helper, `pieceFacts`, emitted AFTER the sentence's own facts by every rule whose subject (or operand, for a relation) is a two-point pair: the touch readers (singular, plural, line-first and circle-subject orders; `TangentTargets.pieces` remembers each pair's noun, a plural «הישרים» reading as lines), the diameter (not the defining «מעגל שקוטרו BD», whose subject is the circle), «AB ⊥/∥ CD» in every spelling (the frame now carries «הישר»/«הישרים» into the relation instead of dropping it), «הצלע AO נמצאת על ציר ה-x», and the converse «(הישר) CD עובר דרך P». «הישר BC» draws the LINE — a new fact `line-2pt` resolved at M1 to the `line-at` through B along B→C (0 DOF), named `BC`; «הקטע / הצלע / הבסיס BC» and the bare «BC» draw the SEGMENT — the very fact the bare «BC» line declares, so the bare line afterwards answers «כבר ידוע». A piece drawn by a sentence that REFERS to its ends carries `ref`, so it never introduces them (#1028; «AC קוטר במעגל» with no A is still `unknown-reference`, deferral included). M1 absorbs a piece the figure already draws: a segment over a polygon side is that side (#1407's one-edge rule; «AB ∥ CD» in a parallelogram is `already-known`), and `line-2pt` over a drawn piece or an existing line BC adds nothing (ruling (a)); «הישר BC» alone is a new canonical sentence, and a later «משוואת הישר BC היא …» replaces the drawn line in place with the stated curve under the same id — never a clash, never two lines.
2. **The extent belongs to the statement** (#1640, #1636). (a) ADR-AG-135's promotion moves from `evaluate` to the M1 `constraint` case: a crossing on a pair the figure draws as a piece AT THE TIME OF THE STATEMENT is bounded; a piece drawn later never re-reads it. (b) A bare pair in an incidence keeps no noun (`lineObject`'s pair, the converse, the centre-by-role canonical): «P על CD» lowers to the line incidence plus a new fact `extent-of`, which M1 resolves against the figure as it stands — a drawn piece over C–D adds the `between` selector «הצלע CD» carries (so a point that cannot lie on it is refused on its line), none leaves the line. «הצלע/הקטע» stays the segment and «הישר» the line, as #1069/#1168 ruled.
3. **The frame reads every list and paste** (#1641, #1643). `NAME_LIST` takes «A, B, C», «A, B ו-C», «A, B, ו-C», «A ו-B»; the subject noun is optional with or without «ה», and the verb is optional when the predicate opens with «על» — never otherwise, so «A ו-B סימטריות» still does not distribute. `orthography` strips format controls with the shared `shell/bidi` set, drops a leading bullet («·», «•», «∙», «*», a «-» followed by a space — a leading minus glued to a number stays an equation), and folds «ה- x» → «ה-x». «מרכז המעגל הוא/היא M» and "the centre of the circle is M" are «M מרכז המעגל».
4. **Ruling (a): the inscribed right trapezoid is refused.** The shape registry gains `notCyclic` («טרפז ישר זווית» → «מלבן»: a cyclic quadrilateral's opposite angles sum to 180°, so two right angles force four — a rectangle, which a trapezoid is not). `cyclicFacts` refuses every inscription spelling of such a noun with the new parse code `inscribed-contradicts-noun`, carrying both nouns; the message names them in each locale («טרפז ישר זווית לא יכול להיות חסום במעגל … הופך אותו למלבן, ומלבן אינו טרפז ישר זווית») and offers the rectangle sentence. #1627's draw-with-a-warning is untouched for givens that force the rectangle later.
5. **Ruling (b): a tangency with no circle states it, centre unnamed** (ADR-AG-196's none → create, extended to the tangency readers). In M1's `tangent-of`, a contextual tangency that finds NO circle first creates `circle-touched`: an equation circle (x−a)²+(y−b)²=r² whose a, b, r are tool symbols (`toolSymbol`, the `θ_` family of the free line's direction — free DOF, solved, never a parameter row; r > 0). No letter is spent: «O מרכז המעגל» names its centre through the derived `circle-centre` an equation circle already has (B1). One circle → bind (as before); several → `ambiguous-shape`, never a pick. The incircle sentence learns the binding too: `the-circle` gains `match: { inscribed }` — a circle the figure already states tangent to every side of the ring IS this circle; when that circle is the touch-created one, it becomes the computed incircle under the same id (its free symbols leave; ADR-AG-160's closed form replaces a solve), so the touch-first spelling builds the as-printed figure.

**Locks** (`issue-1637-g2-parser.test.ts`, 44): T11 and T6 draw their pair and the bare line is «כבר ידוע»; «הישר BC משיק…» draws the line; a diameter never introduces its ends; the audit rows (relation, «הישרים», side on an axis, converse in both nouns); a side is not drawn twice; «משוואת הישר BC» after the drawn line is one object. The operator's #1640 sequence line by line (AB record, AC «כבר ידוע» — the diameter drew it —, BC record) with |OB| = 12, |OC| = 15, |BC| = 3 at four seeds; 12/5 → C(4,3) at six seeds; the out-of-segment incidence refused; the four-spelling parity table with the piece drawn and without it; a later piece never narrows. Every #1641 row ≡ the per-point facts; the four «ה- x» spellings; «A ו-B סימטריות» never distributes. The pasted isolates, four bullet marks, the glued minus, four centre-copula spellings, the no-circle message in both locales. Four inscription spellings of the right trapezoid refused with both nouns in both locales; the trapezoid, the rectangle, the isosceles trapezoid still record. 6/4 typed line by line → all `record`, A(2,−1)/C(−4,5) or the mirror, O, B, K exact at six seeds; the touch line alone draws one circle and no centre letter; 3/5 with the touch line BEFORE the incircle line → every line `record`, one circle, A(−8,0), B(0,6), C(−2,2), D, E, F as printed; one circle binds, two refuse. **Fails before: 34 of 44.**

**Locks changed, each to this decision:** `engine.test.ts` #1063 (a relation over bare points now draws its pairs, so it records; with the pieces drawn it is still "already follows" — #1080's shape for the area); `issue-1281-1495` (the converse ≡ the incidence + the piece; bare «CD» ≡ «P על CD»); `issue-1618-sentence-frame` (a side on an axis draws it; «הישרים» relates lines); `issue-1619-b1` (the centre by role ≡ «M על CD» + «CD»); `issue-1619-b2` («BD קוטר במעגל» records — it draws BD — and is "already follows" once BD is drawn; the right trapezoid lock is ruling (a)'s refusal; the incircle reads through `the-circle`); `issue-1619-integration` (6/4's A and C in either labelling); `issue-1464` (the incircle through `factsWithin`).

**Measured.** 471 corpus (seed 0): **214/263 lines, 19/46 questions** — unchanged (6/4 already landed through `derive`'s deferral; the gain is that it now builds line by line, as typed). 24-seed sweeps, whole: 6/4 24/24 (both labellings occur), 3/5 touch-first 24/24, a touch list on a free triangle 24/24 (148 ms/seed), the two tangents alone 24/24, 12/5 24/24, 13/5 24/24.

**Not built, said out loud.**
- **An axis tangency with no touch point and no circle** («המעגל משיק לציר ה-x» first) keeps the no-circle refusal: an equation circle's axis tangency is judged only at a named touch point (ADR-AG-195 refuses a determined circle's bare axis tangency `out-of-scope`), and lowering it on the created circle is a solver row not built here.
- **«המשיק למעגל בנקודה A» with no circle** (the tangent as an object) is not a tangency STATEMENT and still refuses — the ruling named the tangency/touch sentences.
- **Length givens** («BC = 3») do not draw their pair: a metric is not a relation, and no ruling asked for it.
- **The analytic store does not strip format controls** from the recorded line (2-D/3-D do, ADR-W-029); the parser now does, so the fact is right and the stored text keeps the paste.
- **Ruling (a) vs «הישר» on a side drawn EARLIER:** ADR-AG-135's ruling (a) stands — «הישר CA» stated after the side is drawn denotes the side. #1640's "«הישר BC» is on the line" is implemented as "a piece drawn LATER never narrows it"; whether an explicit «הישר» should also override a side drawn BEFORE is a question for the operator, not changed here.

## ADR-AG-199 — A composed panel row isolates its Hebrew words; a load restores everything the save wrote (#1644, #1632)

**Status:** accepted · 2026-10-01 · operator: "fix these issues so all issues opened here" (#1644 and #1632 auto-ok 2026-10-01, ADR-W-014) · branch `feat/1619-circles` (PR #1637 phase B, group G3).

**Requirements:** [02c](02c-requirements-analytic.md) R136 (new): an option row in the data panel reads in order, and a loaded file shows the AI rows in the student's own words. · **Design:** [04c](04c-design-analytic.md): the bidi table gains the panel-row composer `panelRowText`, and the save envelope section gains the round-trip rule.

**Cites** #1036 (the option set), #1344 / `isolateRtlName` (a Hebrew name inside an LTR row), #1297 (`spokenFor`), #1548 (`disabled` range check), #1631 (`seedNames`), #1102 / ADR-W-053 (locks call the decision), ADR-W-064 (re-measure at pickup).

**Context.**
- **#1644.** On corpus 7/5 (PR #1637 T5) the operator reported *"the −2 is not shown correctly … the 2- is shown also on the screenshot you took"*.
